A_visibility.comparison_standard: Imposed-profile visibility has rms width 247.7 in z; only 55.4% of its probability lies in the wall. The narrow peak is not a narrow normalized visibility distribution. Compare the full function to data before claiming a last-scattering solution.

B_diffusion_scale.comparison: Toy angular ratio 1241, obtained using assumed D_A = ell/(1+z), a wall of imposed Thomson depth 0.9 and one mean-free-path random walk. This is not a Silk diffusion calculation: the diffusion integral needs a time-dependent scattering rate, photon-baryon coupling, sound speed and native perturbation transfer function. Numerical proximity to a CMB damping multipole is not a prediction.

C_wall_ionization_saha.statement: Conditional LTE at assumed local gas temperature 2946 K gives x_e = 0.988 to 0.834. The TEP clock redshift does not independently set local gas temperature. Saha equilibrium requires a verified thermalizing ionizing radiation field and equilibration time. Gamma_required is an alternative photoionization rate for this ionization fraction, not a supplement to LTE; neither it nor the density or radial placement is derived here.

D_wall_placement.statement: At assumed mean neutral density the threshold LyC mean free path is 0.20 Mpc, not parsecs. The imposed wall requires 4.50e+07 recombinations cm^-2 s^-1. Uniform in-situ emissivity would exceed this for some trial cycling rates before escape, dust absorption and geometry; other trial rates fail. The calculation does not locate the edge, determine source distribution, or show that a neutral trough can coexist with the wall.

E_gamma_local_equilibria.statement: For assumed x_e=0.9 in the wing and x_e=1e-5 in the trough, local photoionization balance requires Gamma 4.36e-19 versus 1.05e-29 s^-1, a drop of 4.1e+10. The neutral mean-density LyC mean free path is 0.20 Mpc. No coupled emissivity/attenuation solution is provided; the sharp transition remains a physical requirement.

verdict: An imposed profile produces a peak at z=1080.000, but only 55.4% of normalized visibility lies in the wall (rms width 247.7). Geometric angular ratio 1241 is not a damping-tail prediction. Conditional LTE Saha balance and a local photon budget do not determine temperature, wall location or the ionizing background. Native acoustic modes and dynamical placement remain open.
